pages.text: A repeater listens on its $(thing)input$() frequency and sends what it hears out on its $(thing)output$(), so handhelds that cannot reach each other can talk through it. Handhelds listen on the output and transmit with an $(thing)offset$() (usually 600 kHz) to the input.

It needs a $(l:radiocraft:repeaters/duplexer)duplexer$(/l) on its back, top or bottom, with the antenna's coax on the duplexer. Without one it deafens itself: "psht... psht...".$(br2)Settings: input/output, $(thing)CTCSS$() access and output tones, CW ID, hang time with courtesy beep, and a timeout.
